request_state.context: Beal: A^x+B^y=C^z, x,y,z>=3, gcd(gcd(A,B),C)=1 has no solutions. ALREADY BLOCKED in this project: the modular method on the all-even branch (Azon Hypothesis 5 provably fails for every reduction, derived); Chabauty over the base field (bounds the wrong point set); abc and IUT (give finiteness only, ineffectively); Darmon's program (literature says min exponent 3 is largely inaccessible); extending computation (far behind the literature: min exponent <=113, bases to 2^100, (3,3,p) to p<=10^7). ALREADY KERNEL-VERIFIED here: exponent reduction to {4} u odd primes; bases pairwise coprime; A != B; no counterexample when 3|gcd(x,y,z) or 4|gcd(x,y,z); the all-even case IS perfect powers in a primitive Pythagorean triple; Beal is FALSE over Z[i] (so any proof must use the ordering of Z or ramification of rational primes); and every one of the ten known Fermat-Catalan solutions fails Beal because it has an exponent 2.

candidate.mechanism: Exploit 'exponent 2 is obligatory'. Beal is equivalent to: every primitive hyperbolic solution has an exponent equal to 2. Seek a mechanism explaining WHY 2 is distinguished - e.g. that a solution with all exponents >=3 would force a rational point on a variety whose 2-part is what makes the known solutions possible.
candidate.why_new: Attacks the reformulation rather than the original statement. The distinguished role of 2 is a structural fact not previously exploited here.

genuinely_new.instructions: Is this mechanism materially different from the routes already blocked in this project - the modular method, Chabauty, abc/IUT, Darmon's program, and extending computation - rather than a restatement or a variant of one of them?

criteria.true: it uses a different source of constraint, so it would fail for a different reason than the blocked routes
criteria.false: it is a variant of a blocked route, or it would meet the same obstruction

executable_here.instructions: Can a discriminating test of this mechanism actually be executed with exact computation, elementary derivation, or Lean - with no access to Magma, no large class-group computation, and no new deep theorem?

criteria.true: a concrete test can be run now with exact arithmetic, elementary reasoning, or a proof assistant
criteria.false: it needs machinery not available, such as hyperelliptic Jacobian arithmetic, class groups of high-degree fields, or an unproved theorem

payoff.instructions: If the discriminating test came out favourably, how much would be learned?
criteria: level 0: nothing that is not already recorded
level 1: a minor constraint on hypothetical counterexamples
level 2: a new necessary condition, or a precise specification of what a proof must contain
level 3: a new infinite family excluded, or a genuine reduction of the open problem
